affixes:resistance has no identity-matched Chinese label. Its English text never matches Chinese tooltip text, so an item carrying that affix is skipped rather than classified.

The Chinese text combines sources from different game builds (d2core/d4data 3.2.1.73552 and wowhead 3.0.2 tribute references). Text that no longer matches the game fails to resolve and the item is skipped.

The companion translation source has placeholder names, duplicate aliases and one missing unique record. Placeholders are not shipped, shared unique names need item-type evidence, and unrecognized names are rejected so the item is skipped.
The locale generator keeps runtime_ready and source_quality_ok false while the gaps above exist. The flags are left unchanged; only the listed, guarded gaps are accepted.

basis: Each limitation ships without live-game validation because its runtime handling is fail-closed: text that cannot be identified is skipped, never marked as junk or favorite and never dropped. The release owner permits shipping unavailable or out-of-season locale data as a documented limitation.
